subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: Which payload contract should Feishu legacy card-action callbacks use when passing through `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` to agents?
rationale: The source-reproducible bug is clear, but the permanent format of the synthetic agent message affects existing button/command behavior and downstream agent parsing.

options.title: Sponsor structured JSON passthrough
options.body: Proceed with the linked pull request direction after ensuring parser-boundary preservation, backward-compatible button behavior, focused tests, and real Feishu card-action proof.

options.title: Use command-text append semantics
options.body: Expose form fields by appending tokens to the existing command string, preserving command-style handling but making structured form data less precise.

options.title: Defer to a richer action contract
options.body: Pause the current fix until maintainers define a typed channel action payload instead of delivering these fields through synthetic text.

recommendation.title: Sponsor structured JSON passthrough
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked pull request direction after ensuring parser-boundary preservation, backward-compatible button behavior, focused tests, and real Feishu card-action proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman authored and merged the central card-action and structured interaction paths where the payload contract decision lands.
